name: Ferienwohnung Thaler Georg
beschreibung:
Quietly perched on a hillside in Thiersee, the Thaler family welcomes guests with warm Tyrolean hospitality in a comfortably appointed apartment with a panoramic balcony.

Lake Thiersee and scenic walking paths ascending Mount Pendling are within close reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Thaler Georg in Thiersee offers relaxing days and mountain views in sunny Kufsteinerland.
